text:
Sam: Heads-up team — Aurora marketplace listing + joint integrations blog + partner webinar slated for Aug 9. We need a crisp lead routing plan, UTMs, nightly partner drop spec, and a short benchmark blurb for the launch post. Thoughts?
Renee: I'll take UTMs + landing copy. Proposal: utm_source=aurora_market, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=AUR-LAUNCH-0809. Add hidden fields: partner=aurora, campaign_code=AUR-0809.
Arun: Partner asked for webhook delivery but will accept nightly SFTP if DPA not done. For SFTP: PGP encrypted CSV to their inbound bucket. Also asked for `webinar_engagement` event logs if possible.
Bea: Webinar form fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, region, integration_interest (multi-select), share_with_partner (checkbox, default unchecked). Legal requires exact consent wording; will pull copy from legal.
Sam: Routing rules (draft):
- share_with_partner=true AND integration_interest includes "API" or "SDK" -> partner SDR queue (webhook if available else nightly)
- lead_score >= 75 OR enterprise_domain -> Redwood AE handoff + notify partner (no immediate transfer)
- webinar_attended=true and watch_pct>=50 -> bump +25 to lead_score and re-evaluate
- all others -> co-branded nurture (dev vs product cohorts)
Renee: Also add first_touch attribution: if first_touch=marketplace then partner gets primary credit. Keep a `first_touch_channel` column in nightly CSV.
Arun: CSV header sample for nightly drop (single line):
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,region,role,integration_interest,utm_source,campaign_code,hs_contact_id,lead_score,partner_opt_in,first_touch_channel,consent_timestamp
```
Bea: Add `consent_timestamp` for auditing. Also include `sandbox_request` boolean if they request a dev sandbox so partner can provision.
Sam: For blog benchmark: keep it short and reproducible. Two scenarios: baseline single-node vs Redwood+Aurora routing (batching + KV cache). Method: same 50 prompts, 5 warmups, median p50/p95 latencies and $/1k tokens. Add link to reproducible script in repo. Bea: can you draft the human-friendly blurb?
Bea: Yes — I'll draft a 3-paragraph blurb focusing on methodology, results, and how teams can reproduce. Also will make a tiny screenshot with p50/p95 and cost numbers.
Renee: Landing CTAs: Primary = Register for webinar (ads will drive), Secondary = Try integration sandbox (dev button), Tertiary = Request enterprise POC. Ads to A/B test headlines: A) "Deploy inference integrations faster with Redwood + Aurora" B) "Lower inference cost and latency for product teams — Redwood + Aurora"
Arun: Security note: for webhook payloads include HMAC header (x-redwood-hmac). For SFTP, use PGP and rotate keys monthly. Partner asked for `role` and `lead_score` fields in webhook payload.
Sam: Assignments + due dates: Renee = UTMs + landing copy + ad headlines (due 7/15), Arun = partner delivery spec + webhook + SFTP keys (due 7/12), Bea = webinar form + benchmark blurb + visuals (due 7/18). I'll draft co-branded nurture emails and the initial Marketo smart lists.
ops-bot: Event created: "Aurora marketplace launch ops sync" 7/19 9:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/aurora-launch-sync
Renee: Also — please add HubSpot/Marketo screenshots to the tracking doc once workflows are live: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/aurora-launch. We should include a sample nightly CSV in the folder for partner QA.
Bea: Quick CTA wording for consent checkbox (legal-approved placeholder): "I agree that Redwood may share my contact details with Aurora for follow-up regarding this integration." (default unchecked)
Arun: I'll upload PGP public key and a sample `aurora-sample-nightly.csv` to the shared folder once I provision keys.
Sam: One final ask: include `utm_content` on ad creatives so we can segment by headline variant. Drop any workflow screenshots into the doc before the 7/19 sync. Thanks team :rocket:
